mapper.select: select t.id, t.code, t.name, t.state from pep_platform.tenant t where #{platformAdmin} = true or exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.tenant_member m where m.tenant_id = t.id and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.state = 'ACTIVE') order by t.code

select p.id, p.tenant_id as tenantId, p.code, p.name, p.state from pep_platform.project p where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (#{platformAdmin} = true or exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.project_member m where m.project_id = p.id and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.state = 'ACTIVE') or exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.tenant_member m where m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.state = 'ACTIVE')) order by p.code

select u.id as userId, u.username, u.display_name as displayName, u.state from pep_platform.project_member m join pep_platform.app_user u on u.id = m.user_id where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.state = 'ACTIVE' order by u.username

select r.code from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role r on r.id = b.role_id where b.principal_type = 'USER' and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text and b.scope_type = 'PROJECT' and b.scope_id = #{projectId}::text order by r.code
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.project_member (project_id, user_id, state) values (#{projectId}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE') on conflict (project_id, user_id) do update set state = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: delete from pep_platform.project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from pep_platform.role_binding where principal_type = 'USER' and principal_id = #{userId}::text and scope_type = 'PROJECT' and scope_id = #{projectId}::text
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.role_binding (id, principal_type, principal_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_id) select gen_random_uuid(), 'USER', #{userId}::text, r.id, 'PROJECT', #{projectId}::text from pep_platform.role r where r.code = #{roleCode} and r.scope_type = 'PROJECT' on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select id, code, name, scope_type as scopeType, built_in as builtIn from pep_platform.role order by code
select role_id as roleId, permission_code as permissionCode from pep_platform.role_permission order by role_id, permission_code

select b.id, b.principal_type as principalType, b.principal_id as principalId, b.role_id as roleId, r.code as roleCode, b.scope_type as scopeType, b.scope_id as scopeId from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role r on r.id = b.role_id where b.scope_type = #{scopeType} and b.scope_id = #{scopeId} order by b.created_at, b.id

select u.id::text as id, u.username as code, u.display_name as name, u.state, null::text as context from pep_platform.app_user u where #{query} = '' or u.id::text = #{query} or strpos(lower(u.username), lower(#{query})) > 0 or strpos(lower(u.display_name), lower(#{query})) > 0 order by (u.id::text = #{query} or lower(u.username) = lower(#{query})) desc, (u.state = 'ACTIVE') desc, u.username, u.id limit 30

select s.id::text as id, s.code, s.name, s.state, p.name as context from pep_platform.service_account s left join pep_platform.project p on p.id = s.project_id where #{query} = '' or s.id::text = #{query} or strpos(lower(s.code), lower(#{query})) > 0 or strpos(lower(s.name), lower(#{query})) > 0 or strpos(lower(p.name), lower(#{query})) > 0 order by (s.id::text = #{query} or lower(s.code) = lower(#{query})) desc, (s.state = 'ACTIVE') desc, s.code, s.id limit 30
select id, project_id as projectId, code, name, state from pep_platform.service_account where project_id = #{projectId} order by code
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.service_account (id, project_id, code, name, state) values (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{code}, #{name}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select k.id, k.principal_type as principalType, k.principal_id as principalId, k.name, k.key_prefix as keyPrefix, k.state, k.expires_at as expiresAt, k.last_used_at as lastUsedAt, k.created_at as createdAt from pep_platform.access_key k join pep_platform.service_account s on s.id::text = k.principal_id and k.principal_type = 'SERVICE_ACCOUNT' where s.project_id = #{projectId} order by k.created_at desc, k.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.access_key (id, principal_type, principal_id, name, key_hash, key_prefix, permissions, expires_at, state) values (#{id}, 'SERVICE_ACCOUNT', #{serviceAccountId}::text, #{name}, #{keyHash}, #{keyPrefix}, cast(#{permissions} as jsonb), #{expiresAt}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: update pep_platform.access_key k set state = 'REVOKED' from pep_platform.service_account s where k.id = #{id} and s.id::text = k.principal_id and s.project_id = #{projectId} and k.state = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select id, owner_project_id as ownerProjectId, resource_type as resourceType, resource_id as resourceId, grantee_type as granteeType, grantee_id as granteeId, action, expires_at as expiresAt from pep_platform.resource_grant where owner_project_id = #{projectId} order by created_at desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.resource_grant (id, owner_project_id, resource_type, resource_id, grantee_type, grantee_id, action, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{ownerProjectId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{granteeType}, #{granteeId}, #{action}, #{expiresAt}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from pep_platform.resource_grant where id = #{id} and owner_project_id = #{projectId}
